scope: Phase 2E full Incept production artifact; local synthetic acceptance only

conclusions.reason: Full-site kernel peak 768.0625MiB; configured 768MiB; peak minus limit 65536 bytes; OOM kills 0. Build/start and capacity gates are evaluated separately.

environment.docker: os=linux architecture=x86_64 cpus=8 memory=25201696768 server=29.7.2 kernel=6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2 system=Docker Desktop

postgres.productionDifference: Production Compose: 384MiB, 64MB shared_buffers, max_connections=20, work_mem=2MB; PG fixture remains independently measured.

proxy.transport: isolated HTTP; production HTTPS/TLS cost not measured
proxy.limits: production usage rate 2r/s, burst 5, connection limit 20; forwarded headers overwritten

environment.wholeMachine: Docker VM has about 24GiB and 8 CPUs. Only App cgroup is constrained to 768MiB/2 CPUs. PG, proxy and load generator are separate. 2GiB whole-machine assessment is an accounting estimate, not a 2GiB VM stress run.

measurementMethod.unit: bytes, milliseconds, CPU microseconds unless named otherwise; MiB=1048576 bytes
measurementMethod.cgroup: memory.current / memory.peak / memory.events / memory.stat, cgroup v2. memory.peak is kernel-maintained lifetime peak and includes file cache; survives within one container lifetime, resets after container restart.
measurementMethod.sampler: test-only Next main-thread preload every 100ms; client samples latest snapshot after real requests; raw rows retain actual timestamps
measurementMethod.rss: Next process RSS includes threads; distinct from cgroup charge and from wrapper process. Worker heap is last-reported isolate heap, sampled by actual Owner status, not an exact allocation maximum.
measurementMethod.loop: monitorEventLoopDelay resolution=10ms; reset every 100ms. Reported P99 is max interval P99, not a combined histogram.
measurementMethod.percentile: sorted samples[floor(N*q)], clamped; response bodies fully consumed; no external browser rendering latency
measurementMethod.windows: at least30s request windows. Fixture generation excluded from upload wall. uploadWallMs ends when all uploads have durable committed receipts; requestWindowMs includes trailing page probes.
measurementMethod.cold: baseline-process-cold is after actual Next restart; prior assets/OS cache remains warm. baseline-cold was collected after asset preflight and is warm.
measurementMethod.faults: stress-independent includes explicit restart injection during trailing page probes; its three502s are excluded only from steady availability calculations, retained in raw data. Its pre-restart kernel peak remains a valid resource observation.
